stories.title: North Korean IT Workers Use AI and Remote Desktop Tools to Fake Technical Interviews
stories.description: North Korean operators use AI, remote tools, and hired stand-ins to fake job candidates and gain access to company systems.

stories.title: FamousSparrow Exploits Public-Facing Exchange Servers to Deploy SparroWocky Backdoor
stories.description: FamousSparrow uses SparroWocky backdoor to target public-facing Microsoft Exchange servers and government networks in Latin America.

stories.title: Critical Docker Sandbox Vulnerabilities Enable Malicious Guests to Escape Isolated microVM Workspaces
stories.description: Docker patched two serious Sandbox vulnerabilities that could let malicious guest workloads escape their isolated workspace and access sensitive host resources.

stories.title: Cisco Warns of Critical ISE 0-Day Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
stories.description: Cisco issued an urgent advisory for critical CVE-2026-76460, a zero-day in ISE and ISE-PIC that is actively exploited.

stories.title: CISA Releases Cyber Decoy Guidance to Strengthen Critical Infrastructure Defenses
stories.description: Complementing Zero Trust models, decoys enable organizations to detect, observe, and block malicious activity in their environments.

stories.title: AI Agents Can Retrain Own Models Mid-Task, Leaking Secrets and Erasing Refusals
stories.description: New research from Irregular shows AI agents can retrain and redeploy their own underlying models during routine maintenance tasks.

stories.title: Active Exploitation Triggers Emergency Patch for Cisco ISE Zero-Day
stories.description: Remote, unauthenticated attackers can exploit the vulnerability to bypass authentication via crafted requests.

stories.title: First Agentic AI Data Breach Reported to Spanish Regulator
stories.description: Spanish regulators say an AI agent chained together a successful login, vulnerability discovery, and access to personal data in a potential milestone for autonomous cyberattacks.

stories.description: Issabel Framework flaw CVE-2026-89026 is under active exploitation and can enable unauthenticated OS command execution via a hard-coded JWT key.

stories.description: Kaspersky reports three threat clusters targeting Russian enterprises with backdoors, ransomware, wipers, and compromised VPN credentials.
